
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(BSgenome)
library(Biostrings)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)

setwd(this.path::here())
getwd()
```

### Build a table of 10kb coordinates for the human genome (hg19)

```{r}
chrom_sizes <- read.csv("data/landscapes/hg19.chrom_sizes.txt",
                        sep = "\t", header = FALSE,
                        col.names = c("index", "chr", "size"))
rownames(chrom_sizes) <- chrom_sizes$chr
chrom_sizes <- setNames(chrom_sizes$size, chrom_sizes$chr)
```

```{r}
hg19 <- getBSgenome("BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19")
```

```{r}
coords <- data.frame(
  chr = character(),
  start = integer(),
  end = integer()
)
```

```{r}
for (chr in paste0("chr", c(as.character(seq(1, 22)), "X", "Y"))) {
  chr_length <- chrom_sizes[[chr]]

  starts <- seq(1, chr_length, by = 1e4)
  ends <- pmin(starts + 1e4 - 1, chr_length)

  coords <- rbind(
    coords,
    data.frame(
      chr = chr,
      start = starts,
      end = ends
    )
  )

  print(paste0(chr, " done"))
}

coords$kb_id <- paste0(coords$chr, ":", coords$start)
coords$mb_id <- paste0(coords$chr, ":", (coords$start %/% 1e6) * 1e6 + 1)
```

```{r}
write.csv(coords, "data/landscapes/hg19_1Mb_coords.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### Formating the VCF file to add two additional columns: 1) substitution type, 2) chromosome coordinates
### and then map kb_id and mb_id from coordinates file to the VCF file based on chromosome and position.
```{r}
vcf_b <- read.csv("data/landscapes/SNV_BMemoryDF.vcf", sep = "\t")
coords <- read.csv("data/landscapes/hg19_1Mb_coords.csv")
```

```{r}
call_nucleotides <- function(chr, coord, ref, mut) {
  chr <- sub("^chr", "", chr)
  sequence <- hg19[[paste0("chr", chr)]]
  positions <- (coord - 1):(coord + 1)

  if (min(positions) < 1 || max(positions) > length(sequence)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  trinucleotide <- as.character(sequence[positions])

  if (substr(trinucleotide, 2, 2) != ref) {
    warning("VCF reference does not match genome at ", chr, ":", coord)
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  if (ref %in% c("A", "G")) {
    trinucleotide <- as.character(reverseComplement(sequence[positions]))
    mut <- chartr("ACGT", "TGCA", mut)
  }

  paste0(paste0(trinucleotide, collapse = ""), ">", mut)
}
call_nucleotides("1", 4e6, "C", "T") # example usage
```

```{r}
vcf_b$tri <- mapply(call_nucleotides,
                    vcf_b$chr,
                    vcf_b$pos,
                    vcf_b$ref,
                    vcf_b$mut)
```

```{r}
call_reg_id <- function(chr, pos) {
  chr <- paste0("chr", chr)
  match <- which((coords$chr == chr) &
                   (coords$start <= pos & coords$end >= pos))
  kb_id <- coords[match, "kb_id"]
  mb_id <- coords[match, "mb_id"]
  if (length(kb_id) == 0) {
    return(c(NA_character_, NA_character_))
  }
  c(kb_id, mb_id)
}
```
```{r}
vcf_b[c("kb_id", "mb_id")] <- t(mapply(
  call_reg_id,
  vcf_b$chr,
  vcf_b$pos
))

write.csv(vcf_b, "data/landscapes/SNV_BMemoryDF_with_sub_and_coords.vcf",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

### Compute genomic features for each 10kb region

```{r}
sum_bw <- BigWigFile("data/landscapes/features/wgEncodeUwRepliSeqGm12878SumSignalRep1.bigWig") #nolint
wave_bw <- BigWigFile("data/landscapes/features/wgEncodeUwRepliSeqGm12878WaveSignalRep1.bigWig") #nolint

regions <- GRanges(
  seqnames = coords$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(start = coords$start, end = coords$end)
)
```

```{r}
wave_values <- unlist(summary(
  wave_bw,
  which = regions,
  size = 1,
  type = "mean"
))

sum_values <- unlist(summary(
  sum_bw,
  which = regions,
  size = 1,
  type = "mean"
))
```

```{r}
replication_table <- data.frame(
  kb_id = as.character(seqnames(regions)),
  start = start(regions),
  end = end(regions),
  wave_signal = wave_values$score,
  sum_signal = sum_values$score
)
```

```{r}
replication_table |>
  dplyr::mutate(wave_signal = ifelse((!is.na(wave_signal)) &
                                       (is.na(sum_signal)),
                                     NA, wave_signal)) |>
  summarise(
    mean_wave_signal = mean(wave_signal, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sum_signal = mean(sum_signal, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_wave_signal = median(wave_signal, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_sum_signal = median(sum_signal, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_wave_signal = min(wave_signal, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_sum_signal = min(sum_signal, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_wave_signal = max(wave_signal, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_sum_signal = max(sum_signal, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

### Compute CpG island overlap for each 10kb region
```{r}
matrixCpG <- read.csv("data/landscapes/features/CpG matrix", sep='\t')

cpg_gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(matrixCpG,
                                   keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
                                   seqnames.field = "chrom",
                                   start.field = "chromStart",
                                   end.field = "chromEnd",
                                   starts.in.df.are.0based = TRUE)
```

```{r}
cpg_gr <- keepStandardChromosomes(cpg_gr, pruning.mode = "coarse")
hits <- findOverlaps(regions, cpg_gr)
```

### Compute GC content for each 10kb region
```{r}
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19)
genome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19

v  <- Views(genome, regions)  # lazy, so it avoids loading all sequences
gc <- letterFrequency(v, "GC")        # counts of G + C per bin
acgt <- letterFrequency(v, "ACGT")

gc_content <- ifelse(acgt > 0, gc / acgt, NA_real_)
```

```{r}
features <- data.frame(
  kb_id = coords$kb_id,
  mb_id = coords$mb_id,
  gc_content = gc_content
)
```

```{r}
width(pintersect(regions[queryHits(hits)], cpg_gr[subjectHits(hits)]))
```

```{r}
hits |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  summarise(
    max_index = max(queryHits),
    min_index = min(queryHits),
    max_width = max(width(pintersect(regions[queryHits(hits)],
                                     cpg_gr[subjectHits(hits)]))),
    max_subject = max(subjectHits)
  )
```


```{r}
intersected_widths <- width(pintersect(regions[queryHits(hits)],
                                       cpg_gr[subjectHits(hits)]))

# 3. Sum widths per 10-kb window index (handles multiple islands in the same bin)
summed_widths <- tapply(intersected_widths, queryHits(hits), sum)

# 4. Initialize a zero vector of length equal to your total regions (288,113)
cpg_coverage <- numeric(length(regions))

# 5. Map the summed widths back to their exact region positions by index
cpg_coverage[as.integer(names(summed_widths))] <- summed_widths

# Optional: Convert to fraction of the 10-kb window covered (range 0 to 1)
cpg_fraction <- cpg_coverage / width(regions)
```

### Combine all features into a single data frame and save to CSV
```{r}
features$cpg_fraction <- cpg_fraction
features$replication_wave_signal <- replication_table$wave_signal
```

```{r}
write.csv(features, "data/landscapes/features/features_10kb.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)
```
